name: Frederick County, Maryland (United States)
description: "Frederick, the Crossroads of Maryland": the red, yellow, black and white of the Maryland flag arranged as intersecting shapes forming a crossroads pattern, with a white vertical bar and a black horizontal bar meeting at the centre.
history: Catoctin Mountain Park in the county is the location of Camp David, a U.S. presidential retreat, and Fort Detrick, a U.S. Army base. The flag was adopted in 2023 (designed by Marc DeOcampo and selected in June 2023 in a redesign contest announced by County Executive Jessica Fitzwater for the county's 275th anniversary, according to Flags of the World; Wikidata dates the previous flag 1976–2023).

features.role: red and yellow accents of the crossroads
